verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm whose client-facing technology, such as the trademark extranet, could plausibly include an AI assistant, so the axis applies. The only AI evidence describes tools lawyers use for brief analysis and due-diligence extraction. Nothing shows a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to inside the product, so this is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Lawyers simply upload a legal brief into the interface, which then quickly identifies highly relevant cases that are not cited in the brief.
